maya: Heads up — HF->Redwood tokenizer conv for an spm model produced a subtle token-id drift after merge reordering. sanity check?
alex: what drift exactly — vocab order change or special tokens moved?
maya: the exported merges sequence got non-monotonic ordering; the converter reordered a few ops which shifted later ids. small example below. can reproduce locally.
jordan: which converter commit? we changed merge dedupe logic last week.
maya: repro snippet in case it helps. note the pair appears but indices jump around near the block.
```
# hf merges excerpt
10 11
11 12
11 13
# converter output
10 11
11 13  <-- 12 got pushed down
11 12
```
maya: result: a sentinel token (<|sentinel0|>) that was id 50256 in HF became 50257 post-conversion. chattemplate serialization in tests baked numeric ids so lookups shift.
sam: that breaks kv-cache alignment and some evals. did CI catch this?
ci-bot: convert-tokenizer-test failed (exit 1)
ci-bot: failing test: token-id-consistency.test — mismatched ids for 3 tokens: [50256 -> 50257, 32011 -> 32010, 42 -> 43]
alex: @maya run `python tools/inspect_tokens.py --compare hf_vocab.json rw_vocab.json --limit 20` and paste output?
maya: pasted snippet:
```
50255: "</s>"
50256: "<|sentinel0|>"  <-- hf
50256: "<|pad|>"         <-- rw
50257: "<|sentinel0|>"  <-- rw
```
maya: chattemplate parsing expects sentinel ids contiguous with other special tokens; our serialized templates use raw ids which now mismatch.
lee: two likely causes: (1) unstable merge sorting in the converter, (2) converter ignoring config.json's special token map when assigning final indexes.
jordan: I suspect the dedupe patch used a dict and iteration depended on insertion order. fix is to sort merges deterministically (by original rank and token pair).
sam: short-term workaround: allow `special_token_overrides` in redwood_config.json to pin problematic ids e.g. `{\"<|sentinel0|>\": 50256}` — but that's manual.
alex: longer term: (a) revert unstable iteration change, (b) add validation gate in onboarding CI that runs token-id-consistency.test and blocks on any special-token deltas, (c) prefer serializing chattemplates with token strings not raw ids where feasible.
maya: quant/eval note: saw ~0.4 ROUGE drop on codegen prompts on the converted model — likely tokenization shift around common prefixes.
jordan: action items: open PR to make merge ordering stable (I'll do it), add unit tests comparing HF tokenizer.json <-> converted vocab mapping, add CI gating for special token id deltas, document `special_token_overrides` as emergency.
maya: I'll attach minimal tar and a tiny repro script in the issue. thanks. :pray:
sam: :thumbsup: I'll run the dedicated quant + kv-cache bench after PR lands.
ci-bot: issue created RW-INT-8472 "spm merge reordering causing special-token id drift" assigned to jordan
maya: reassigning to @jordan for converter fix. closing thread, will reopen if regressions persist.
